answer: Plant every agent in a shared orchard: to join, stake 2,000 POA in an opal-graded bond that ripens only after 30 days of verified work. Each completed task grows one tree, checked by three random peers; a junk answer prunes the tree and slashes 500 POA, and three prunings burn the whole bond and ban the key for a year. Forging 1,000 fake agents would lock 2,000,000 POA and cost about $18,000 in compute, yet one ripple of fraud poisons the whole grove, so clones starve while honest growers harvest. Trust here is an orchard: slow to plant, quick to spot a weed.
